ordered_boundary: verify exact no-argument, cwd, module, self, sealed V3r16 subjects, future different-auditor authorization, and output parent
CREATE_NEW write-through reserve fixed V3r16 evidence and binary outcome receipt
open only the exact V3r15 contract using GENERIC_READ and FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE|FILE_SHARE_DELETE
record exact CreateFileW result and GetLastError
read and hash snapshot one from the same handle

read and hash snapshot two from that same handle

diagnostic_truth.win32_error_rule: Capture GetLastError immediately for a failing Win32 call; use ERROR_INVALID_DATA for a completed API whose returned attributes, path, identity, size, byte count, or digest violates the sealed contract.
diagnostic_truth.success_meaning: Only that the V3r15 contract could be stably observed twice through one handle during this new bounded run. It does not reinterpret or retry V3r15.
